tools.name: add_ssh_key
tools.title: Add an SSH key
tools.description: Adds an SSH public key (a line from a .pub file) to the account. Needs user:write.

public_key.description: The public key line, e.g. ssh-ed25519 AAAA… you@laptop

tools.name: create_instance
tools.title: Rent a GPU server
tools.description: Rents the server of an offer and starts it with a template. Billing starts right away and runs every minute until you stop or destroy it. Confirm the price with the user first. Needs instances:write. The response has the instance id; poll get_instance until status is running (usually 1–5 minutes).

disk_gb.description: Disk size, GB (use the template's recommended_disk_gb)

image.description: Docker image, only with the custom template

ssh_key_ids.description: SSH key ids to install (default: all of yours)

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same value when retrying the same request, so a retry never rents twice

tools.name: destroy_instance
tools.title: Destroy a server
tools.description: Destroys a server and deletes its disk for good; billing stops completely. Irreversible: confirm with the user. Needs instances:write.

tools.name: estimate_vram
tools.title: Estimate VRAM for an AI model
tools.description: How much GPU memory an AI model needs (LLMs such as Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, Gemma, GPT-OSS; image and video models such as FLUX, SDXL, Wan) at a given precision and context length, and which GPUs on gpu.nz fit it with their current price. Call without `model` to list the known models.

precision.description: Weights precision: "fp16", "fp8", "q8", "q6", "q5", "q4" (LLMs; default q4 for LLMs, fp16 for image models)

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Account and balance
tools.description: The signed-in account and its balance, hourly burn and runway. Needs a key with user:read and billing:read.

tools.name: get_instance
tools.title: Get one server
tools.description: Status, SSH command, app URLs (ComfyUI, Jupyter, chat…), price and cost so far of one server. The root password is left out unless include_password is true (your SSH keys are installed on every server).

tools.name: get_instance_logs
tools.title: Server logs
tools.description: The last lines of a server's container log: boot progress, app start-up, errors. Needs instances:read.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.title: Get one offer
tools.description: Details and the current price of one offer by id (from search_offers).

tools.name: list_gpu_models
tools.title: List GPU models
tools.description: GPU models available on gpu.nz right now with VRAM, class and the cheapest hourly price per GPU. Use it to pick a gpu_slug for search_offers.

min_vram_gb.description: Only models with at least this much VRAM per GPU

tools.name: list_instances
tools.title: List my servers
tools.description: Your rented servers with status, GPU, price and SSH command. Needs instances:read.

status.description: active (default): servers that are not destroyed; all: include destroyed ones

tools.name: list_ssh_keys
tools.title: List SSH keys
tools.description: SSH public keys on the account; they are installed on new servers. Needs user:read.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: Ready environments a server can start with: ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion Forge, Ollama + Open WebUI, vLLM, Jupyter/PyTorch, Kohya, FluxGym, Unsloth, chats with preloaded models, plain Ubuntu + CUDA, or a custom Docker image. Pass `slug` as `template` to create_instance.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.title: Search GPU servers
tools.description: Search rentable GPU servers (offers) with live prices. Returns the cheapest matches first unless `order` says otherwise. Each result has an offer id for create_instance.

gpu.description: GPU model slug(s), comma-separated, e.g. "rtx-4090-24gb" or "h100-sxm-80gb,h100-pcie-80gb" (see list_gpu_models)

num_gpus.description: GPUs per server, comma-separated, e.g. "1" or "2,4,8"

max_price_rub_h.description: Maximum price for the whole server, rubles per hour

min_reliability.description: Minimum host reliability, 0–1 (0.98 is a good bar)

min_disk_gb.description: Minimum disk the server can give, GB

type.description: on_demand (default) or interruptible (cheaper, can be preempted)

order.description: Sort: price (default), dlperf_per_price for value, reliability, vram, inet_down

tools.name: start_instance
tools.title: Start a server
tools.description: Starts a stopped server again; GPU billing resumes. Confirm with the user. Needs instances:write.

tools.name: stop_instance
tools.title: Stop a server
tools.description: Stops a running server: the GPU is released and billing drops to the disk only. Data on the disk is kept and the server can be started again (the GPU may then be taken by someone else; gpu.nz finds a replacement when it is). Needs instances:write.

tools.name: topup_link
tools.title: Top-up link
tools.description: A link to the balance top-up page (SBP, crypto) for the user to open in a browser; payments never happen through the API. Optionally pre-fills the amount.

amount.description: Amount in the account currency (rubles by default)
